name: travel-ui-soft-filled
label: 页面功能柔和面性图标
preamble: Friendly front-facing travel utility icons with rounded filled silhouettes, one clear subject, generous spacing, and no outlines, text, shadows, or decorative detail.

revision_2.notes: Review keeps its accepted geometry with a richer violet palette; exchange is an orange circle with a white dollar sign; checklist uses a visible medium-blue folded corner.

revision_3.notes: Seven remaining semantic spot icons. The language globe was intentionally removed from both former placements after visual approval.

construction.grid: 24-unit keyline; live area about 80%; optical sizing
construction.detail_budget: one subject per icon; at most three simple color regions
construction.fill_rule: flat filled silhouettes; light color only for essential structure
